user.title: Choose a target type
user.description: Pick the closest role. HA Probulator uses it only to suggest sensible ports, icons, groups, latency thresholds, and probe behavior; everything remains editable.

data_description.preset: A starting profile for this target. It does not lock the target to a protocol or device class.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure target
reconfigure.description: Change the target name, host, or TCP port.

monitoring.title: Monitoring options
monitoring.description: Choose how HA Probulator should probe this target. These settings can be changed later.

data_description.group: Optional label used by HA Probulator overview and summary cards.
data_description.icon: Icon used by target entities and custom cards.
data_description.timeout: Seconds allowed for each TCP connection attempt.
data_description.retries: Extra attempts within a probe cycle after the first attempt fails.
data_description.retry_delay: Seconds to wait between retry attempts.
data_description.failure_threshold: Consecutive failed probe cycles required before the target becomes offline.
data_description.recovery_threshold: Consecutive successful probe cycles required before the target becomes online again.
data_description.warning_latency_ms: Response time at or above this value is considered degraded.
data_description.critical_latency_ms: Response time at or above this value is considered critical.
data_description.statistics_window: Number of probe cycles retained for rolling latency and success-rate calculations.
data_description.dependency_target_id: Optional upstream HA Probulator target. If it is unavailable, this target is shown as Dependency offline instead of producing a misleading independent outage.
data_description.adaptive_polling: Temporarily probe more frequently while the target is degraded, unstable, or offline.
data_description.degraded_scan_interval: Seconds between probes while the underlying target is degraded, unstable, or still establishing state.
data_description.offline_scan_interval: Seconds between probes while the underlying target is offline.
data_description.flap_window: Number of recent probe results used to detect rapid success/failure changes.
data_description.flap_threshold: Number of success/failure transitions inside the flap window required to mark the target Unstable.

target.title: Add target
target.description: Enter the address and TCP service HA Probulator should monitor.

data_description.name: Friendly name used for the Home Assistant device.
data_description.host: DNS name or IP address reachable from Home Assistant.
data_description.port: TCP service port to probe. The suggested value comes from the selected target type.

error.invalid_host: Enter a host name or IP address, not a URL.
error.name_too_long: Name must be 80 characters or fewer.
error.host_too_long: Host must be 253 characters or fewer.
error.group_too_long: Group must be 80 characters or fewer.
error.critical_must_exceed_warning: Critical latency must be greater than warning latency.
error.probe_budget_too_large: The timeout/retry combination could keep a probe cycle busy for more than 60 seconds. Reduce the timeout, retries, or retry delay.
error.flap_threshold_too_high: The flap transition threshold must be lower than the flap detection window.
error.dependency_cycle: That dependency would create a dependency loop.

abort.already_configured: That host and TCP port are already being monitored.
abort.setup_incomplete: Setup could not continue because the target details were not available.

init.title: Monitoring options
init.description: Tune polling, retry/debounce behavior, grouping, and latency thresholds.
